data_models:
AetherConfig: Central configuration data class (~130 fields) holding all app settings including protocol (MASQUE/WG/GOOL/ZERO_TRUST), noise mode (FIREWALL/GFW/OFF/BALANCED/AGGRESSIVE/LIGHT), scan mode (TURBO/BALANCED/THOROUGH/STEALTH/IRONCLAD), IP mode, MTU, SOCKS/HTTP ports, routing rules, split tunneling packages, Psiphon chain settings, Cloak settings, Cloudflare Zero Trust credentials, DNS settings, tunnel engine, connection mode (TUNNEL/PROXY_ONLY/SYSTEM_PROXY), and i18n language. Supports protocol-specific profile save/load, preset application, JWT expiry parsing, and localized Zero Trust error validation.

Enums: AetherProtocol (MASQUE/WG/GOOL/ZERO_TRUST), AetherNoise (FIREWALL/GFW/OFF/BALANCED/AGGRESSIVE/LIGHT), AetherScanMode (TURBO/BALANCED/THOROUGH/STEALTH/IRONCLAD), AetherIpMode (AUTO/IPV4/IPV6/DUAL), AetherPerfProfile (AUTO/LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH), AetherLogLevel (OFF/ERROR/WARN/INFO/DEBUG), TunnelEngine (HEV_TUN2SOCKS/SOCKS_TUN_BRIDGE), PsiphonChainMode (AUTO/ALWAYS/FALLBACK), ConnectionMode (TUNNEL/PROXY_ONLY/SYSTEM_PROXY), ConnectionStatus (STOPPED/STARTING/VALIDATING/DATAPLANE_VALIDATED/SOCKS_READY/TUN_ACTIVE/RUNNING/RECONNECTING/STOPPING/ERROR/FAILED), RoutingMode (TUNNEL/DIRECT/BLOCK), SocksReadiness (NOT_READY/LISTENING/PROBED_OK).

AppInfo: Installed app metadata (name, packageName, icon, isSystemApp).
LogEntry: Log record (id, timestamp, level: LogLevel INFO/WARN/ERROR/DEBUG, tag, message).
SessionTraffic: Traffic stats (uploadedBytes, downloadedBytes, uploadSpeedBps, downloadSpeedBps).
UpdateInfo: App update metadata (version, versionCode, isBeta, changelog, releaseUrl).
IpInfo: Public IP info (ip, country, countryCode, flagEmoji, isLoading, error).
PingState: Ping measurement (ms, isPinging, error).
RoutingRule: Pattern-based routing (pattern string + RoutingMode).

OnboardingStep enum (LANGUAGE_SELECT/WELCOME/PROTOCOL_TEST/VPN_PERMISSION/NOTIFICATION_PERMISSION/BATTERY_OPTIMIZATION/SUCCESS/COMPLETED). ProtocolTestStatus (WAITING/PREPARING/REGISTERING/IDENTITY_READY/CONNECTED/FAILED/TIMED_OUT/CANCELLED). ProtocolAttemptResult (protocol, status, error). OnboardingState (currentStep, protocolResults, isProcessing, error, selectedScanMode, activeProtocol, permission flags).

SpeedTestState: Speed test state (phase, config, result, progress, live metrics). SpeedTestResult (pingMs, jitterMs, downloadBps, uploadBps, downloadMbps, uploadMbps, pingSamples, serverName). SpeedTestConfig (selectedServer, displayMode, sizes, streams, custom URL). SpeedTestPhase (IDLE/PING/DOWNLOAD/UPLOAD/COMPLETE/ERROR/CANCELLED). SpeedTestServer (CLOUDFLARE/OFAKIN/CUSTOM).

AutoDetectState: Auto-detect pipeline state (phase, protocolResults, mtuResult, noiseResults, scanModeResults, finalResult, liveFingerprint). AutoDetectPhase (IDLE/FINGERPRINTING/PROTOCOL_SCAN/MTU_PROBE/NOISE_PROBE/SCAN_MODE_PROBE/ANALYZING/COMPLETE/ERROR). AutoDetectResult (recommended protocol/noise/scanMode/MTU/IPMode/H2/ECH/fragment settings, confidence score, NetworkFingerprint). ProtocolProbeResult, MtuProbeResult, NoiseProbeResult, ScanModeProbeResult, NetworkFingerprint (networkType, supportsDPI, supportsUDP, supportsIPv6, DNS servers, ISP, IP).

RegistrationResult sealed interface (Success/TimedOut/Failed/Cancelled).
repositories:
AetherConfigRepository: Singleton managing AetherConfig persistence via Settings key-value store. Loads/saves all config fields with prefix-based namespacing. Supports protocol-specific profile save/restore (per-protocol settings saved under 'protocol_<PROTO>_' keys). Provides preset application (turbo/thorough/stealth/ironclad/custom), full config JSON export/import, onboarding step tracking, WireGuard constraint enforcement, Psiphon egress region caching, and log level propagation. Exposes StateFlow<AetherConfig> and StateFlow<Boolean> for onboarding completion.

IpInfoRepository: Singleton object for public IP geolocation. Fetches IP info from 7 parallel sources (ip.sb, ipwho.is, freeipapi, ipify, ifconfig.me, ipinfo.io, Amazon checkip) via both direct and SOCKS proxy connections with retry logic. Uses OkHttp with SOCKS proxy. Generates country flag emojis. Exposes StateFlow<IpInfo>.

LogRepository: Singleton in-memory log store with persistence to Settings. Sanitizes sensitive fields (access tokens, keys). Enforces configurable log levels for app and core logs. Caps at 1000 entries with FIFO eviction. Exposes StateFlow<List<LogEntry>>. Supports optional file log writer callback.

PingRepository: Singleton for TCP+HTTP ping measurement. Performs TCP connect timing then HTTP 204 latency test via SOCKS proxy or direct connection. Uses configurable ping URL. Exposes StateFlow<PingState>.

SpeedTestRepository: Singleton for network speed testing. Measures ping/jitter (sampled), multi-stream download, and upload throughput. Supports Cloudflare/Ofakino/Custom servers. Persists config (server, sizes, streams, display mode) to Settings. Exposes StateFlow<SpeedTestState> with live progress metrics.

AutoDetectRepository: Singleton for automated network fingerprinting and optimal config detection. Pipeline: internet check, IPv6/UDP/DPI detection, ISP identification, protocol latency probing (MASQUE/WG/GOOL), MTU binary search, noise mode evaluation, scan mode testing. Produces AutoDetectResult with confidence score. Exposes StateFlow<AutoDetectState>.

DnsBenchmarkRepository: Singleton for DNS server benchmarking. Tests multiple DNS servers via UDP DNS queries with latency measurement, TLS certificate validation, and reachability checks. Supports parallel probing with semaphore-based concurrency control. Exposes StateFlow with benchmark results.

ActiveProxyProvider: Simple singleton holding the current Psiphon SOCKS proxy URL (psiphonProxyUrl).

PsiphonEgressRegistry: Singleton maintaining available Psiphon egress regions via StateFlow<List<String>>. Validates 2-letter country codes. Used by AetherConfigRepository for region selection.
view_models:
AetherViewModel: Main application ViewModel. Initializes repositories (LogRepository, SpeedTestRepository, DnsBenchmarkRepository), ConnectionController, and all platform-specific providers. Exposes StateFlows for: config, connectionStatus, elapsedSeconds, sessionTraffic, logs, ipInfo, pingState, installedApps, updateInfo, battery optimization status, crash log, toast state, import conflicts, MTU optimization progress, Zero Trust scroll-to flag, login code waiting state. Core methods: toggleVpn (start/stop VPN or proxy), forceStop, updateConfig (with smart restart detection for 16+ fields), restartConnection (stop-wait-start cycle), updateTunnelEngine, split tunneling management (single/bulk app mode updates), routing rule CRUD (add/remove/update/clear), MTU optimization (binary search ICMP DF-bit probing), protocol auto-detect application, DNS list application, update checking (GitHub raw JSON), crash log management, backup/restore (full config JSON and routing rules), and clipboard/share utilities.

OnboardingViewModel: First-run onboarding flow ViewModel. Manages step progression (LANGUAGE_SELECT -> WELCOME -> PROTOCOL_TEST -> VPN_PERMISSION -> NOTIFICATION_PERMISSION -> BATTERY_OPTIMIZATION -> SUCCESS -> COMPLETED). On desktop, skips permission steps. Handles protocol test execution (MASQUE/WG/GOOL sequential testing), permission verification polling (400ms intervals, 60 attempts), scan mode selection, and language selection. Persists step progress to AetherConfigRepository.
business_logic:
Connection Management: The app operates as a VPN/proxy client supporting 4 protocols: MASQUE (HTTP/2-3 tunneling), WireGuard, Gool (WG-in-WG double encryption), and Cloudflare Zero Trust. Connection modes include TUNNEL (system VPN via TUN device), PROXY_ONLY (local SOCKS/HTTP proxy), and SYSTEM_PROXY (Windows system proxy). The ConnectionController singleton manages connection state machine (STOPPED->STARTING->VALIDATING->DATAPLANE_VALIDATED->RUNNING with RECONNECTING and ERROR states). Smart restart logic automatically detects when config changes require connection restart.

Split Tunneling: Per-app routing with three modes: tunneled (forced through VPN), blocked (denied access), and excluded (bypass VPN). Supports bulk operations.

Routing Rules: Pattern-based traffic routing with TUNNEL/DIRECT/BLOCK modes. Supports regex patterns. Import/export in JSON and .astb format. Conflict resolution on import (merge or replace).

Auto-Detection Pipeline: Multi-phase network analysis: fingerprinting (IPv6, UDP, DPI, ISP detection) -> protocol latency probing -> MTU discovery (ICMP DF-bit binary search) -> noise mode evaluation -> scan mode testing -> confidence-weighted configuration recommendation.

DNS Benchmarking: Parallel UDP DNS queries to multiple resolvers with latency measurement and TLS validation.

Speed Testing: Multi-phase (ping/jitter/download/upload) with configurable servers, stream counts, and display modes.

Psiphon Integration: Optional Psiphon chain mode (auto/always/fallback) with egress region selection and protocol chaining (MASQUE/WG/Gool as outer layer).

Cloak Integration: Optional Cloak plugin with SNI rotation, TTL lists, jitter, fallback ports, and adaptive mode.

Zero Trust: Cloudflare Zero Trust integration with team name, email auth, service tokens, or access tokens. JWT expiry parsing. OTP-based login flow.

IP Geolocation: Parallel multi-source IP lookup via 7 providers, supporting both direct and proxy-proxied requests with retry logic.

Update System: Checks GitHub raw JSON for new versions, compares semantic versioning + version codes.

Security: Sensitive data redaction in logs (tokens, keys, certificates). Onboarding flow ensures VPN/notification/battery permissions before first use.
state_management: Architecture follows MVVM with repository pattern. All state is held in Kotlin StateFlow/MutableStateFlow, collected in Compose via collectAsStateWithLifecycle(). Single AetherViewModel as main ViewModel, single OnboardingViewModel for onboarding flow. AetherConfigRepository is singleton with protocol-specific profile save/restore. All repositories (IpInfo, Log, Ping, SpeedTest, AutoDetect, DnsBenchmark) are Kotlin object singletons with their own MutableStateFlow-backed state. ConnectionController is a singleton managing connection state machine with StateFlow for status, elapsed time, and session traffic. CompositionLocalProvider provides i18n strings (AppStrings) based on language config. Theme supports RTL (Farsi). Platform-specific functionality injected via expect/actual pattern (PlatformContext, Settings, VpnController, SystemUtils, AppInfoProvider). TrayState singleton for desktop tray navigation events. Configuration changes trigger automatic connection restart when relevant fields change.
ui_screens_list:
OnboardingScreen: Multi-step first-run wizard (language selection, welcome, protocol testing, VPN/notification/battery permissions, success).
DashboardScreen: Main connection screen with protocol selector, connect/disconnect button (swipe/capsule style), session timer, upload/download traffic, IP info with country flag, ping display, and Psiphon toggle.
SettingsScreen: Multi-page settings (protocols, noise, scan mode, MTU, ports, DNS, split tunneling entry, routing rules entry, auto-detect entry, speed test entry, logs config, backup/restore, Zero Trust, Cloak, Psiphon, advanced settings).
LogsScreen: Log viewer with level filtering, copy, share, and clear functions.
AboutUsScreen: App version, credits, and info.
SplitTunnelingScreen: Per-app routing with search, bulk selection, and mode toggles (tunnel/block/exclude).
RoutingRulesScreen: Pattern-based routing rule management with add/edit/delete, import/export, conflict resolution.
AutoDetectScreen: Network auto-detection with progress visualization and DNS benchmark section.
SpeedTestScreen: Network speed test with real-time metrics and results.
UpdateScreen: App update notification with changelog and download link.
CrashReportScreen: Crash log display with copy/share/restart.
MainScreen: Top-level navigation with HorizontalPager (Dashboard/Settings/Logs/About) and curved iOS-style bottom nav bar. Manages sub-screen navigation via NavHost. Handles onboarding gate, crash log gate, and update notification gate. Includes Zero Trust login dialog and desktop admin-required dialog.
